instruction: Rename file1 to data.txt, then copy data.txt into each of dir1, dir2, and dir3.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

result.command: bash -c '[ ! -e /home/user/file1 ] && echo "FILE1_GONE:YES" || echo "FILE1_GONE:NO"; [ -f /home/user/dir1/data.txt ] && echo "DATA_IN_DIR1:YES" || echo "DATA_IN_DIR1:NO"; [ -f /home/user/dir2/data.txt ] && echo "DATA_IN_DIR2:YES" || echo "DATA_IN_DIR2:NO"; [ -f /home/user/dir3/data.txt ] && echo "DATA_IN_DIR3:YES" || echo "DATA_IN_DIR3:NO"'

metadata.task_rationale: Varies original copy task by adding a rename step (mv) before copying, testing the model's ability to chain rename + copy operations
